name: Yuanbao Inc. American Depositary Shares
summary: Yuanbao Inc., operating through its subsidiaries, manages an online platform for insurance distribution and various related services throughout the People's Republic of China. The company offers a diverse portfolio of insurance policies, including medical, critical illness, and life coverage. Beyond its core insurance offerings, it also provides specialized system services, which encompass precise marketing strategies and advanced analytics capabilities. Yuanbao Inc. was founded in 2019 and maintains its corporate headquarters in Beijing, China.
